'''Darren Combs''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[June 2001 Centerville tournament]] on 16 June 2001 with Weird Dark Deck, that does nothing, according to Alex George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2464">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-16-centerville-ohio-6-16-01d2464/ centerville-ohio-6-16-01], DeckTech (Alex "george3785" George, 16 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-16-centerville-ohio-6-16-01d2464/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
